name: humanizer
description: Takes a draft you paste (an email, a message, a memo, a post, or another agent's draft) and returns the same draft without AI-writing patterns: inflated phrases ('serves as a testament', 'delve'), chatbot openers and closers ('I hope this helps!'), filler, 'not only... but also', em-dash overuse and padded lists. It is a style pass, not a rewrite: every number, name, date, link, quote and the structure stay exactly as they were, checked in code; if a pass can't keep them, you get your draft back unchanged. It reports the AI-pattern density before and after (it never claims to beat AI detectors). Follow-ups: show the changes, keep my em dashes, more casual or formal, shorter, as json. English only; it writes nothing new, translates nothing and answers no general questions.

skills.name: Humanize a draft
skills.description: Removes AI-writing patterns from the draft you paste and keeps its facts, names, numbers, links, quotes and structure, with the AI-pattern density before and after and a list of changes.
examples: Can you make this sound more natural? <paste your draft>
Remove the AI tone from this email, keep my em dashes: <paste the email>
